title: Potion Notifier
description: Add Custom Potion Notifications, To know when you run out!
body:
# 🧪 Potion Notifier

Stay in control of your effects with clean, customizable notifications.

Potion Notifier alerts you when your active potion effects are about to expire or end with fully customizable titles, subtitles, sounds, and timing.


---

## ✨ Features

### 🔔 Smart Notifications
- Get notified when potion effects are about to expire  
- Optional notification when effects end  
- Fully configurable warning time per potion  

---

### 🎨 Titles & Subtitles
- Separate Title and Subtitle toggles  

---

### ⚙️ Per-Potion Settings
- Enable / disable each potion individually  
- Set custom warning time  
- Toggle warnings on/off  
- Toggle sounds on/off  

---

### 📋 Clean In-Game GUI
- Add, edit, and remove potions easily  
- Built-in potion icons  
- Simple and responsive interface  
- Warning toggle inside GUI  

---

### 🧠 Quality of Life
- Sort potions (A-Z)  
- Default preset loader  
- Capitalized potion names  
- Stable and optimized system  

---

## 📦 Requirements
- Mod Menu — for customization  

---

## 💡 Perfect For
PvP, survival, and modded gameplay where timing matters.
